# SAMPLE DARK STAR — high risk lead
**Summary:** Risk score 80/100 in Sample Marine Reserve (synthetic). Investigation complete.

## What happened
- 2026-10-02T04:00:00Z: gap

## Why it matters
- Global Fishing Watch recorded 1 AIS reporting gap(s) associated with Sample Marine Reserve (synthetic).
- Longest dark period lasted 100 hours (3+ days).
- Apparent fishing began within 48 hours of the vessel reappearing after a dark period.
- The recorded positions at either end of the gap are about 158 km apart.
- Has used more than one flag: XXX, QQQ.
- Has used more than one name: SAMPLE DARK STAR, SAMPLE NIGHT STAR.
- Repeat pattern: 5 tracking gaps in the previous 12 months.

## What public sources say
Search results for analyst verification:
- [1] [Synthetic: SAMPLE DARK STAR listed for IUU fishing](https://example.org/synthetic/iuu-list)
- [2] [Synthetic: fleet overview](https://example.org/synthetic/fleet)
- [3] [Synthetic: company registry entry](https://example.org/synthetic/company)

## What we don't know
- AIS endpoints do not establish the route, the activity during the gap or why reporting stopped.
- Public search results need an analyst to verify the identity, date and claim against the original record.

## Suggested next steps
- Request the vessel track.

_Global Fishing Watch detections are *apparent* activity inferred from AIS. A tracking gap can have innocent causes (equipment failure, poor satellite coverage). This is a lead for review, not proof of illegal fishing._
